It counts toward NCAAW scoring level, home edge and both teams' attack and defense corrections (it's how teams with no standings on the routes build a record of their own).

Across 239 graded NCAAW games the algo now scales scoring ×1.003 and gives home teams +1.3 points. Team corrections start after 3 graded games for a team.

review.title: Bottom line
review.body: Wrong side, total within its normal range, margin outside its normal range (off by 42.8 points), no bet.
